title: Text: DET Ron Colangelo ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: Thinking out loud but this Cabrera stuff is unfortunate. Lynn's past column, "days are numbered in Detroit" headlines, even George's story on Friday was too much.
This is why the best player of our generation won't ever open up his baseball mind. He's been better this season than he ever has before, though I suspect that's just a relationship thing.
